sources.title: Michigan Department of Licensing and Regulatory Affairs, Bureau of Community and Health Systems — Notice of Involuntary Transfer or Discharge and Facility-Initiated Discharge for Nursing Homes, LARA-BCHS-ITD-100 (PDF)
sources.notes: Fillable form. Retrieved by curl with a browser user-agent and extracted with pdftotext -layout, matching the 2026-08-30 hand capture's own recorded method. Deliberately no strip-page-numbers filter: the per-page footer ('LARA-BCHS-ITD-100 (07/26/2024)', 'Authority: P.A. 368 of 1978 as amended', 'Page N of 7') is the form's own printed text, not a page-number artifact to discard, per the standing packet's capture notes. The two-column layout of the state and federal reason lists is the form's own arrangement; the extractor renders it as interleaved lines, which is the form as printed, not a capture defect.

sources.title: Michigan Department of Licensing and Regulatory Affairs — Guidance in the Preparation of a Notice of an Involuntary Transfer or Discharge (PDF)
sources.notes: Retrieved and extracted the same way as source 1. Reproduces the statute inside the department's own guidance; the indentation, the running foot ('Guidance in the Preparation of a Notice of an Involuntary Transfer or Discharge', 'September 12, 2013') and the department-name substitutions inside the quoted statute are the guidance document's own, per the standing packet's capture notes — none of that is stripped.

sources.title: Michigan Department of Community Health, Medicaid Provider Bulletin MSA 04-20, "Hospital Leave Days" (PDF)
sources.notes: A one-page provider bulletin, captured whole — no slice, the document is the bulletin. Sets the 98-percent-occupancy condition on Medicaid paying to hold a bed during a hospital leave; no more current statement of this rule was located on michigan.gov, whose Medicaid Provider Manual pages are a JavaScript-driven document library rather than a per-chapter address this project's bounded transports could fetch, so this bulletin is quoted as the newest version located from this publisher, per the manual-maintenance line on its own last page directing providers to retain it 'until the Michigan Medicaid Provider Manual is updated.'

sources.title: Michigan Department of Community Health, Medicaid Provider Bulletin, Long Term Care Facilities 00-05, "Nursing Facility Leave Days" (PDF)
sources.notes: A three-page provider bulletin, captured whole — no slice. States the ten-day hospital-leave hold and the 18-day therapeutic-leave allowance under a 365-day period; same publisher-currency caveat as source 3, and this bulletin is likewise the newest version located from this publisher for these two leave-day rules.
